class.name: Gun
class.brief_description: Gun base class, to handle shooting logic.
class.description: Gun is a class that is spawned in the world, and shoots by spawning a [Bullet] stored in a [PackedScene] [param Bullet Resource]

method.name: shoot
method.description: Called to Shoot the gun. Tries to spawn [param Bullet Resource] at [param Muzzle]. First [code]get_child(0)->call("_on_shoot");[/code] calls [method RecoilScript._on_shoot], then a [param Bullet Resource] is spawned for each [Vector2] spawned.

method.name: _process
method.description: Checks if input action [code]"Shoot"[/code] was just pressed, and if so calls [method shoot].

method.name: print_type
method.description: Print the type of the variant.

members.member: Reference to the [Node3D] that represents the muzzle, where the [param Bullet Resource] will spawn.
Reference to the [PackedScene] that contains the [Bullet] and other [Node](s) to spawn.
